description: This file defines the CallScript class, which implements the <script> element in the MiniLang language used within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides functionality for executing scripts or invoking other methods specified in XML configuration, including handling inline scripts and external script locations.

classes.name: CallScript
classes.description: Represents a <script> element in the MiniLang language, facilitating execution of embedded or external scripts within a method context.

classes.name: CallScriptFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of CallScript from XML Elements.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Replaces deprecated or outdated attribute 'error-list-name' in the XML element, indicating the correction performed.

methods.name: CallScript
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a CallScript object based on XML element attributes and inline script content, performing validation and parsing location/method info.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the script or method invocation as specified by the CallScript instance within the provided method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the CallScript element, including its attributes.
